GPU_MEM_SIZE = 80 # GB

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

def _kvpr(w, mem):
    """KVPR = weighted req rate / free memory."""
    return w / (GPU_MEM_SIZE - mem) if mem < GPU_MEM_SIZE else float('inf')


def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Greedy placement (min resulting KVPR) followed by a local search that
    repeatedly moves or swaps models between GPUs whenever it strictly
    reduces the maximum KVPR across GPUs. Simple and fast.
    """
    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    shared_kv = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]
    weighted_req_rate = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx = None
        best_key = (float('inf'), float('-inf'))
        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            free = shared_kv[gpu_id] + model.model_size
            if free < GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                ratio = (weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / (GPU_MEM_SIZE - free)
                key = (ratio, -free)
                if key < best_key:
                    best_key = key
                    best_idx = gpu_id
        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot place model of size {model.model_size} GB")
        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        weighted_req_rate[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        shared_kv[best_idx] += model.model_size

    # Local search: bottleneck-targeted ejection chains (depth-1 moves, swaps,
    # and depth-2 chains off the argmax-KVPR GPU), accepting only strict
    # improvements of the global max KVPR. All states remain memory-feasible.
    improved = True
    rounds = 0
    while improved and rounds < 500:
        rounds += 1
        improved = False
        kv = [_kvpr(weighted_req_rate[g], shared_kv[g]) for g in range(gpu_num)]
        cur = max(kv)
        b = kv.index(cur)  # bottleneck GPU
        found = False
        for i in list(placement[b]):
            ra, sa = i.req_rate / i.slo, i.model_size
            w_b, m_b = weighted_req_rate[b] - ra, shared_kv[b] - sa
            # depth-1: move i from bottleneck to another GPU
            for g2 in range(gpu_num):
                if g2 == b or shared_kv[g2] + sa >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                    continue
                new = kv[:]
                new[b] = _kvpr(w_b, m_b)
                new[g2] = _kvpr(weighted_req_rate[g2] + ra, shared_kv[g2] + sa)
                if max(new) < cur - 1e-12:
                    placement[b].remove(i); placement[g2].append(i)
                    weighted_req_rate[b], shared_kv[b] = w_b, m_b
                    weighted_req_rate[g2] += ra; shared_kv[g2] += sa
                    improved = found = True; break
            if found: break
            # depth-1: swap i with a model on another GPU
            for g2 in range(gpu_num):
                if g2 == b: continue
                for j in list(placement[g2]):
                    rb, sb = j.req_rate / j.slo, j.model_size
                    if (shared_kv[b] - sa + sb >= GPU_MEM_SIZE or
                            shared_kv[g2] - sb + sa >= GPU_MEM_SIZE):
                        continue
                    new = kv[:]
                    new[b] = _kvpr(w_b + rb, m_b + sb)
                    new[g2] = _kvpr(weighted_req_rate[g2] - rb + ra,
                                    shared_kv[g2] - sb + sa)
                    if max(new) < cur - 1e-12:
                        placement[b].remove(i); placement[g2].remove(j)
                        placement[b].append(j); placement[g2].append(i)
                        weighted_req_rate[b] = w_b + rb; shared_kv[b] = m_b + sb
                        weighted_req_rate[g2] += ra - rb
                        shared_kv[g2] += sa - sb
                        improved = found = True; break
                if found: break
            if found: break
            # depth-2 chain: move i from bottleneck to g2, then relocate some
            # model k (from any GPU) to the bottleneck (backfill) or a third GPU
            for g2 in range(gpu_num):
                if g2 == b or shared_kv[g2] + sa >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                    continue
                w_2, m_2 = weighted_req_rate[g2] + ra, shared_kv[g2] + sa
                for gk in range(gpu_num):
                    for k in list(placement[gk]):
                        if k is i:
                            continue
                        rk, sk = k.req_rate / k.slo, k.model_size
                        # KVPR of gk after k leaves, consistent with chain state
                        if gk == g2:
                            kv_gk = _kvpr(w_2 - rk, m_2 - sk)
                        else:
                            kv_gk = _kvpr(weighted_req_rate[gk] - rk,
                                          shared_kv[gk] - sk)
                        tgts = [b] + [g3 for g3 in range(gpu_num)
                                      if g3 not in (b, g2, gk)]
                        for gt in tgts:
                            new = kv[:]
                            new[b] = _kvpr(w_b, m_b)
                            new[g2] = _kvpr(w_2, m_2)
                            new[gk] = kv_gk
                            if gt == b:
                                if m_b + sk >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                                    continue
                                new[b] = _kvpr(w_b + rk, m_b + sk)
                            else:
                                if shared_kv[gt] + sk >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                                    continue
                                new[gt] = _kvpr(weighted_req_rate[gt] + rk,
                                                shared_kv[gt] + sk)
                            if max(new) < cur - 1e-12:
                                # commit chain: i: b->g2, k: gk->gt
                                placement[b].remove(i); placement[g2].append(i)
                                weighted_req_rate[b], shared_kv[b] = w_b, m_b
                                weighted_req_rate[g2] += ra; shared_kv[g2] += sa
                                placement[gk].remove(k); placement[gt].append(k)
                                weighted_req_rate[gk] -= rk; shared_kv[gk] -= sk
                                weighted_req_rate[gt] += rk; shared_kv[gt] += sk
                                improved = found = True; break
                        if found: break
                    if found: break
                if found: break
            if found: break

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the algorithm

    from evaluator import generate_test_gpu_models
    from evaluator import calculate_kvcache_pressure
    from evaluator import safe_float
    import numpy as np

    test_cases = generate_test_gpu_models()
    all_kvpr = []
    for i, (gpu_num, gpu_models) in enumerate(test_cases):

        results = compute_model_placement(gpu_num, gpu_models)
        max_kvpr = calculate_kvcache_pressure(results)
        all_kvpr.append(safe_float(max_kvpr))

    avg_kvpr = np.mean(all_kvpr)
    if avg_kvpr != 0:
        avg_kvpr = 1.0 / avg_kvpr


    print(f"Max KVPR: {avg_kvpr:.3f}")
